title: Assert original-error preservation and missing-parent acceptance in Windows state-path controls
outcome: Strengthen the existing Windows state-path guard regression controls so preserving the original io::Error and accepting independently observed missing-parent error3 are discriminated, without weakening fail-closed path policy.
acceptance: Unresolved namespace-observation and unrelated primary-error controls assert the original io::Error raw code survives as the error-chain cause, with independent-observation context where applicable.
A real missing-parent spelling exercises native error3 through the guard and remains distinct from unresolved denial; relevant focused controls pass without retries, waits or timeout inflation.
